Estimation by means of the Kalman smoother of a time-dependent canonical decomposition (generic solution)

Source: R/tdarima.R
tdarima_decomposition.Rd

Estimation by means of the Kalman smoother of a time-dependent canonical decomposition (generic solution)

tdarima_decomposition(data, regular, seasonal, parameters, se = FALSE)

Arguments

data

The series (a ts).

regular

The orders of the regular part of the SARIMA models (p,d,q)

seasonal

The orders of the seasonal part of the SARIMA models (bp,bd,bq). NULL is (0,0,0)

parameters

The time dependent parameters. The matrix contains for each column all the parameters of the model, with the columns corresponding to an observation. So, the number of columns is identical to the length of the series and the number of rows corresponds to the arima parameters (regular + seasonal), with eventually the innovation variances

se

Specifies if the standard deviations of the components are computed

Value

A mts object is returned, with the trend, the seasonal, the irregular components and - if requested - their standard deviations

Details

The arima parameters are organized in the following order: phi, bphi, theta, btheta

Examples

s<-rjd3toolkit::ABS$X0.2.09.10.M
n<-length(s)
r<-runif(n*2,-1,-.6)
p<-matrix(r, nrow=2, ncol=n)
p<-rbind(p, runif(n))
sa<-rjd3sax::tdarima_decomposition(s, c(0,1,1), c(0,1,1),parameter=p, se=TRUE)
ts.plot(ts.union(s, sa$components[,1], sa$components[,1]+sa$components[,3]), col=c('gray', 'blue', 'magenta'))
#> Error in ts(x): 'ts' object must have one or more observations
ts.plot(sa$components_stdev, col=c('red', 'blue', 'magenta'))
#> Error in ts(x): 'ts' object must have one or more observations
